title: Laboratory Order Processing Procedure
content:
SOP: Laboratory Order Processing Procedure (SOP-LAB-001)
DEPARTMENT: Laboratory Operations
VERSION: 2.0
ROLES: doctor, nurse, lab_tech
PURPOSE: Prompt, error-free accessioning and panic value reporting.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Laboratory Order Processing Procedure in full compliance with Laboratory Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Laboratory Order Processing Procedure in full compliance with Laboratory Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Laboratory Order Processing Procedure in full compliance with Laboratory Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Laboratory Order Processing Procedure in full compliance with Laboratory Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Laboratory Order Processing Procedure in full compliance with Laboratory Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Laboratory Order Processing Procedure in full compliance with Laboratory Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Laboratory Operations.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-LAB-001 Laboratory Order Processing Procedure v2.0, Section 4
